title: Tenure / App experience — mobile inset gutter symmetry
summary: Fixed 0px/32px asymmetric left/right gutter across all 13 mobile screens on Tenure / App experience by setting counterAxisAlignItems=CENTER on each Scroll content frame (Vertical Auto Layout, 390px wide): 358px-wide inset elements (Card · primary, CTA · primary, CTA · ghost, Notification banners, custom inset frames) now automatically center at x=16, restoring 16/16 symmetric breathing space, while full-bleed 390px elements (Screen hero, List rows, Padded areas) remain at x=0 unchanged. Updated gutter-contract documentation on 6 mobile component definitions (Card · primary, Mobile CTA · primary/ghost, Notification banner info/action-required/success).
mechanism: counterAxisAlignItems MIN → CENTER on 13 Scroll content frames
spacing_token: VariableID:1:23 (Spacing / lg, 16px) — not bound as a padding value; gutter derives from centering math, not a new padding. No raw 16 values introduced.

accessibility.touch_targets: CTA buttons remain 52pt height (AAA ≥44pt confirmed, unchanged by fix)
accessibility.contrast: No fills, strokes, or colour tokens changed. All existing contrast pairs intact.
accessibility.wcag_o1: Advance: gutter symmetry reduces visual asymmetry stress for low-vision users scanning the layout. No regressions introduced.

side_effects: None. Full-bleed elements (390px) centered in a 390px container remain at x=0. Only 358px elements shifted from x=0 to x=16.
